The <b>Crawfather</b> is a [[Bosses (Silksong)|boss]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. He is the lord and justice of the [[Court of Craws]] bringing death with his steel-plated beak.<ref name=hj/> His defeat grants the [[Craw Memento]] and the [[Crawbell]].

== Background ==
Crawfather is the leader of the [[Craws]] and the Judge of their Court.<ref name=hj>Crawfather [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Lord and justice of Pharloom's craws. Delivers death to condemned bugs with his steel-plated beak."</i></ref> 

== In-game Events ==
In Act 3, as the [[Void]] invades [[Pharloom]], Crawfather sends summons for [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]], calling her a "defiler" and possibly blaming her for the destruction caused by the Void.<ref>Crawfather [[Needolin]] dialogue: <i>"A calamitous criminal!"</i></ref><ref>Crawfather Journal Entry: <i>"Did he recognise my part played in this land's void-strung state?"</i></ref>

After receiving the [[Craw Summons]] and returning to [[Craw Lake]], Hornet can turn in the Summons at a gate within the Craw home. Doing so lets her pass into the Court of Craws, where Crawfather and his jurors decide Hornet's verdict. After being defeated, Crawfather will drop the [[Craw Memento]], which absolves the bearer of any past and future crime.<ref>[[Craw Memento]] description: <i>"Iron emblem of the Court of Craws, absolving the bearer of all crimes past and future."</i></ref> If Hornet returns to the arena after resting on a bench, Crawfather's body is nowhere to be seen.

=== Phase 2 (Crawfather) ===
Once all waves have been defeated, Crawfather flies in himself to deliver punishment to [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]. Crawfather shuffles around the arena and performs the following attacks:

* <b>Summon Juror<!--Witness To The Stand--></b>: Crawfather screams, summoning either 2 Craw Jurors, 1 Tallcraw Juror, or 1 Squatcraw Juror. Crawfather will attempt to use Summon Juror in between all other attacks as long as there are no enemies still alive.
** This attack can be interrupted by bouncing on top of his metal head-piece.
* <b>Triple Peck<!--Order In The Court--></b>: Crawfather reels his head back before pecking the ground 3 times, moving forward with each attack.
* <b>Dive Peck<!--Justice From On High--></b>: Crawfather leaps up, fluttering horizontally for a short while to line up with Hornet, and then lunges diagonally downwards towards Hornet with his beak. Upon striking the ground, he bounces forwards slightly.
** While fluttering mid-air, if his metal head-piece is struck, Crawfather will descend back down and cancel the rest of the attack.
* <b>Chain Punishment<!--Chains For The Penitent--></b>: Crawfather charges up before leaping into the air and sending 6 chains in all directions, with 3 spaced out to his left and right. After a moment, the chains erupt in barbed spikes. Crawfather then dives beak-first back down to the ground. He gains this attack after reaching 780 HP.
* <b>Backstep</b>: Crawfather makes a quick shuffle backwards if Hornet is too close to him.

All of Crawfather's attacks, including contact with him, deal {{Damage|2}}, except Chain Punishment, which deals {{Damage|1+1}}. Crawfather's metal headpiece makes him immune to any damage that strikes his head from above, though it can still be bounced off of with Needle bounces.

<hr />

{{Stagger
| Crawfather falls onto his back. Any remaining Craws continue to attack.
| 19
| game = SS
}}

<hr />

* The Jurors are stronger versions of the Crawbugs from earlier in Greymoor. Tactics from before are just as effective in dispatching them, though bear in mind that the spiked crowns on the Tallcraw and Squatcraw Jurors make aerial down-attacks ineffective.
* Prioritise defeating any Jurors that join the fight. The fight becomes more complex when handling multiple enemies. Alternatively, Crawfather will not summon additional Jurors if any are still alive. As the Craw Jurors are easier to dodge than the other Jurors, 1 Craw Juror can be kept alive to prevent Crawfather from summoning other more threatening Jurors.
* Despite being a winged [[Bosses (Silksong)|boss]], Crawfather spends a lot of time on the ground, and is highly vulnerable to ground-based [[Tools]] such as [[Tacks]] and [[Cogwork Wheel]].
* Tools that specialise in damaging aerial enemies, such as [[Curveclaw]], [[Curvesickle]], and [[Threefold Pin]], are also useful in this fight to clear the Jurors Crawfather summons.

== Location ==
Crawfather can be found in [[Greymoor]], in the basement of the large building in Craw Lake. Once [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] obtains the [[Craw Summons]] and presents it to the door inside the building, she can head down into the Craw Court.

== Trivia ==
* The stand of Craws in the background react by shrieking whenever Crawfather is staggered, and fly away upon his defeat.
* In Crawfather's [[Needolin]] dialogue, the word "Spinderous" is used, which is a made-up word with unclear meaning, but may relate to words such as "spin", "spindle" and "spider".
** The word "Clattorous" is another made-up word with unclear meaning, but may relate to words such as "clatter" and "clamorous".
